items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One of the first bands I put together that I was real excited about was the band that finally made my first recording, Tones For Joan’s Bones, with Steve Swallow, Joe Farrell, Joe Chambers, and Woody Shaw.

ctx.x: There’s a recording, Women At the Turkish Baths. Steve was another mentor of mine, and a great friend in helping me work my way through how to be a musician in New York. He was very friendly. He advised me, for instance, to go ahead and be on the Sweet Rain record. The original group for Sweet Rain was Roy Haynes and Steve Swallow, but then Stan didn’t want to use Roy on that gig for some reason, whatever, and because of that, Steve, in a group spirit, said, “well, I’m not going to be on the record either.” So…
